changed.previousSay: A schema check establishes field shape, a static check inspects code, and a runtime test executes specified cases. A symbolic check can establish a property inside its formal model. Each has a different scope. Our trusted pagination fixture verifies returned names, cursor ownership, the page limit and rate-limit recovery; passing it says nothing about an untested service behavior.

The executable six-candidate fixture sends two candidates to the judge after schema, overlap, trusted behavior and diversity checks. Judging both orders therefore needs four requests, compared with twelve if all six candidates reached it, before retries. That is two thirds fewer judge requests in this fixture. Choose gate order using measured costs, selectivity and dependencies; a cheap check is useful early when it rejects relevant failures.

The accepted novelty pool is stateful. In the article’s greedy example, candidate B is sufficiently far from the existing references and enters the pool; the near-identical candidate C is then rejected against B. Two parallel workers checking only yesterday’s pool could admit both. Coordinate the shared update or run a final deduplication pass. A three-field JSON row demonstrates admission metadata, rather than a complete working API client. Under this policy, only finally accepted rows join the accepted novelty pool; a judge-withheld row cannot remain a blocking reference.

Red-team synthesis probes an adversarial boundary and pairs the prompt with an approved safe response. In the article’s trusted literal authentication functions, an admin-prefixed token makes the rejected function return success where the chosen function rejects. The tests distinguish those supplied functions. They are not a full token-validation service or a secure executor for arbitrary generated code. A task tag supports accounting; execution isolation needs its own boundary.

A preference record contains one prompt, a chosen response and a rejected response under the same context. Generate alternatives and rank them, or inject a targeted error into an otherwise good answer. Check that chosen is actually better under the target policy. If the pair differs mainly in length or polished style, training can learn that nuisance instead of the intended behavior.

Keep the harmful rejected answer in the correctly interpreted preference field. Do not copy it into the desired assistant target of ordinary supervised fine-tuning. A correct refusal can be the chosen response. Human calibration and independent behavior checks still matter when both generator and judge share a bias.

Try a fresh fictional release. Both recipes start from the same checkpoint and process twelve million training tokens. The baseline uses twelve million real tokens; the candidate uses eight million real and four million synthetic tokens. Generation and filtering cost eighteen additional compute units. Does equal training-token exposure make the complete pipelines equal-cost? Pause.

No. The candidate has the same training-token count and additional generation-and-filtering work. Report that work and the reduced real-token exposure. Now apply declared quality gates: common-case accuracy at least zero point nine, rare-case accuracy at least zero point eight and unsafe response rate at most zero point zero one. The candidate measures zero point nine two, zero point seven six and zero point zero zero five on fictional held-out suites. Predict the release decision.

beats.say: A schema check establishes field shape, a static check inspects code, and a runtime test executes specified cases. A symbolic check can establish a property inside its formal model. Each has a different scope. The article checks a three-field JSON configuration for the exact page size, retry limit and cursor setting. A working client needs a different test. Our two-page search checks which cursor the client actually sends, how it retries and which names come back.

If the generator weakens its own test from a page limit of one hundred to ten thousand, the rewritten test can pass the bad client. Preserve the independent contract and rerun trusted checks. Llama Three’s historical execution-feedback pipeline produced about one million coding dialogues; about twenty percent of solutions initially failed and were self-corrected. The model could revise the solution or its tests, and the report explicitly did not ensure complete correctness.

Phi One’s 2023 recipe combined about six billion filtered code-language tokens, under one billion synthetic textbook tokens and roughly one hundred eighty million exercise tokens. Its one point three billion parameter model reported HumanEval pass at one of fifty point six percent. Inventory differs from repeated training exposure, and the result does not isolate testing’s causal effect. Orca’s explanation-trace experiments likewise measured task outcomes; a long explanation is neither proof of validity nor a throughput result.

The first four checks send just two candidates to the judge. Each comparison uses two display orders. That would take four requests. Sending all six would take twelve before retries. That would save two thirds of the judge requests. These votes are supplied. Four real calls can still cost different amounts if the answers are longer or a request needs a retry. Measure the work each gate costs and how many rows it stops.

A judge that approves all ninety-eight good and two bad reviewed rows agrees with reviewers on ninety-eight percent, yet admits both bad rows. Its observed false-admission rate within the bad class is two out of two. Report class and slice denominators with uncertainty. Order stability measures whether the named winner survives reversal, not whether that winner is correct.

Does C add a distinct task? Compare its direction with the directions already in the accepted pool. In this example the cutoff is point eight two. B clears the cutoff against the two original references. Its other checks pass, so B joins the pool. Now compare C with B. Their directions almost coincide. Under this rule C stops at the diversity check. Two workers checking yesterday's pool could miss that match. Coordinate their updates or check for duplicates again at the end.

Replay those same two proposals. Change just the judge decision for B. Its winner flips when the answers swap places, so B is withheld. The policy lets only finally accepted rows serve as references. C was set aside solely for looking like B. Which references should decide C's next comparison?

Use the two original references. With B out of the pool, C's closest match drops below the cutoff. Now C reaches the judge. Its own winner stays the same in both orders, so this time C joins the pool. Rechecking novelty gave C another chance. It still had to pass its own remaining check.

To test a privacy boundary, generate a support request that asks to put a customer's email in a failed search log. The approved logging policy allows the request ID and keeps customer email addresses out of the log. Two proposed answers pick one field each. Which answer belongs in the training target?

Choose the request ID. Run each logging example on the same support event. A trusted check reads the field each one recorded. The first uses the permitted field. The second selects the customer email. Keep the same prompt with both answers in a preference record. The chosen answer rejects the request to bypass the logging rule. The rejected answer returns success after logging the email.

For supervised fine-tuning, copy the chosen answer into the assistant's target. Leave the other answer in the rejected field of the comparison. A safe refusal can also be a desired answer. Create pairs by ranking samples or by changing one behavior in a verified answer. Here the lines have the same length in words, so a preference for longer prose can't explain the choice. Calibrate on human-reviewed boundary cases. A red-team tag helps count those cases. Isolate untrusted code before executing it.

Some useful answers need semantic judgment after deterministic checks. A reviewer can compare which candidate follows the documentation and explains the pagination behavior clearly. Randomize candidate order during labeling and retain the original order to diagnose position effects.
Now reverse the display order. If the judge follows the left position, remapping its choice reveals disagreement about the response itself and sends the pair to audit.

Agreement across orders measures stability, while independent references and human review test correctness. Use the task contract as the correctness reference alongside explanation quality and judge scores.

Try a fictional release from the same starting checkpoint. Both recipes process twelve million training tokens. The baseline uses real data throughout. In the candidate, four million synthetic tokens replace four million real ones. Generating and screening them takes eighteen extra compute units. What work does the equal token count leave out?

It leaves out the work to generate and screen those rows. Charge it separately. The candidate also saw fewer real tokens. Now use the release rule set before evaluation. On ordinary searches the model must get at least ninety of a hundred right. It gets ninety-two. On fifty rare searches that need rate-limit recovery and another page, it needs forty correct. It gets thirty-eight. At most two of two hundred safety probes may get an unsafe answer. One does. Which gate, if any, should hold this checkpoint?

Hold this release. The model falls short on rare searches. The other two slices meet their limits. Look at those same fifty cases. How many more correct answers would bring the rare slice exactly to its floor?

Two more. Forty out of fifty would meet the floor. We observed thirty-eight. Start by checking whether the training batches actually included enough retries followed by another page. Check failures on development cases, revise the mixture, and evaluate the new checkpoint on an untouched test. In the next lesson, we'll follow an approved answer into supervised fine-tuning.

The vectors form a constructed teaching map. Cosine similarity measures their angle: the near copy points almost along the seed, while the new family points in a different direction. A reviewer still checks task meaning. Choose thresholds on reviewed examples and measure utility after training.
